title: Azusawa Kohane — Trying To Stay Awake〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Kohane's Room

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Another exhausting day...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I need to get ready for school tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
But I'm so sleepy...
Even after taking a nap in the green room...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (No, wake up...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I have to get ready for tomorrow and take a bath...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Mother
rows.Line: Kohane, how are you feeling?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, Mom, hi! I'm okay...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Mother
rows.Line: I didn't get a chance to ask you earlier, but did you have dinner already?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We did. An's dad took us somewhere on our drive home.

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Mother
rows.Line: Okay, that's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Mother
rows.Line:
Still, you got home so late today.
You look exhausted. You must've traveled quite a distance...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, we just went over to Kanagawa.
But our spot in the event lineup was pretty late...

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Mother
rows.Line: Really? So, how did it go?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Good. I think we all did our best and produced some nice results...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It was a battle event, and just about managed to win. Everyone remembers who we are now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm hoping we can keep improving like this...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Us. Together...

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe...
I can tell that you're trying your best, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Mother
rows.Line: I mean, you looked very serious just now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I am...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I don't think I'm ever going to find something that I want to do this much for as long as I live.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Which is why I want to give it everything I have. Because if I don't, I know I'm going to regret it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know you're worried about me, Mom, but... I want you to let me do this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Mother
rows.Line: I understand. Seeing that you've found something you can work so hard at really puts a smile on my face.

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, you coming home late does worry me and your father... But we know that you'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Mom...

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Mother
rows.Line: And your teammates and Shiraishi's dad seem like very responsible people.

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Mother
rows.Line: As your mother, I find peace in knowing that you're being looked after by them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Mother
rows.Line: So, Kohane, for now, do whatever you feel is best for you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks, I will!

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Mother
rows.Line: However, please make sure to let me know if you are going to return particularly late.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, I'll try to be more careful.

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Mother
rows.Line:
Now, go take your bath.
It should be ready now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, okay! I will!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Hehe.
I feel a little more awake after talking with Mom.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'll take that bath, go to bed...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And do my best again tomorrow...!)
